name: Lake Braies
imageAlt: A wooden boathouse on Lake Braies beneath the Dolomites at sunset
tagline: A little closer to the extraordinary.
description: Still turquoise water. Pine-covered shores. Peaks that seem to touch the sky. Tucked into the Dolomites, Lake Braies is an invitation to slow down and take the scenic route.
highlights: Find a quiet spot by the water
tip: Check local access and parking arrangements before travelling; seasonal restrictions may apply.

name: Lake Garda
imageAlt: Mountains and distant town lights reflected in Lake Garda at night
description: Follow the shoreline past little harbours, dramatic cliffs, and colourful lakeside towns. Lake Garda brings mountain scenery and a slower Italian rhythm together in one beautiful place.
highlights: Watch the boats from the harbour
tip: Choose a town as your base and check local ferry timetables before planning a day on the lake.

name: Koh Lipe
imageAlt: A long-tail boat beside the white sand and turquoise water of Koh Lipe
tagline: Trade your everyday for ocean blue.
description: Long-tail boats drift over clear water, sandy paths lead to the sea, and the day follows the tide. This small island in southern Thailand is made for unhurried exploration.
tip: Boat services depend on weather and season. Check conditions locally and respect marine park rules.

name: Cappadocia
imageAlt: Hot-air balloons above snow-covered valleys in Cappadocia
description: Discover sculpted valleys, cave architecture, and a landscape that feels like another world. Start with a walk, follow a new trail, and leave room for a little wonder.
tip: Balloon flights are weather-dependent. Confirm availability and safety details directly with a licensed operator.
